藏品名称_ZN: 包含的盒子--淡黄色和黑色
描述_EN: 'contained box' looks at ideas of containment, and a balance and layering of materials. andrea walsh (b.1974) studied fine art at staffordshire university before completing her ma in glass at edinburgh college of art. intimately scaled, the work evokes a sense of preciousness and value, with the translucent glass box inviting the viewer to investigate what lies within. it marked a progression from walsh's earlier delicate box forms with cast glass lids, of which the v&a holds two in its collection (c.127-2012 and c.128-2012). she has since incorporated ceramics into her practice, exploring the complimentary qualities of fine bone china and glass. this piece was the first in a new collection of works that developed the theme of boxes and vessels within walsh's work, and was exhibited at collect open 2015 in london.
描述_ZN: '包含的盒子'关注的是包含的概念，以及材料的平衡和分层。 ANDREA WALSH（1974年出生）在斯塔福德郡大学学习美术，然后在爱丁堡艺术学院完成了她的玻璃专业硕士学位。 亲密的比例，作品唤起了一种珍贵和价值的感觉，半透明的玻璃盒子邀请观众去研究里面的东西。 它标志着沃尔什早期带有铸造玻璃盖子的精致盒子形式的进步，V&A在其收藏中拥有两个盒子（c.127-2012和c.128-2012）。 她将陶瓷融入到她的实践中，探索精细骨瓷和玻璃的互补性。 这件作品是Walsh作品中发展盒子和容器主题的新作品系列中的第一件，并在2015年伦敦的Collect open上展出。
